stage.quote: Company: ZenRows, Inc. Raised: €1.1M. Round: pre-Seed. Funding Month: June 2022.
stage.note: Only known priced round is a €1.1M pre-seed (June/July 2022); no later round found. Crunchbase separately buckets this round under its 'Seed' stage grouping, but the round type itself is Pre-Seed.

total_funding_usd.basis: €1.1M converted at ~1.045 USD/EUR (approx. rate at announcement); matches the only funding round found (pre-seed, 2022)
total_funding_usd.quote: ZenRows, a London, UK-based web data automation startup, closed €1.1 million in its first funding.

last_round.quote: The round was led by 4Founders Capital. Athos Capital and Bynd VC have also participated in the operation, as well as Javi López (Erasmusu).

revenue.basis: Third-party marketing case-study video ('How ZenRows scaled to $5M ARR with content and SEO', LinkedIn, June 2025); not confirmed by ZenRows itself. Company's own About page only states it is 'profitable' without a figure.
revenue.quote: How ZenRows scaled to $5M ARR with content and SEO

note: Founded 2021 in Bilbao/Getxo, Spain by Aurken Bilbao (CEO) and Ander Rodriguez, now fully remote across ~8 time zones. Company describes itself as profitable. Only one confirmed funding round found (€1.1M pre-seed, mid-2022, led by 4Founders Capital); no evidence of any later round or accelerator participation (no YC/a16z/Techstars etc. match found). Legal entity name appears inconsistently as 'ZENROWS, S.L.' (company site) vs 'ZenRows, Inc.' (The SaaS News) — likely a US entity alongside the Spanish one.
